title: pimUML Model (PIM)
description: Strict JSON Schema for the pimUML Platform-Independent Model. Covers the class diagram (Class, Property, Association, AssociationClass, Enumeration, PrimitiveType) and the state machine diagram (StateMachine, Region, State, Pseudostate, Transition, Trigger) according to UML 2.5.1.

classes.description: All Class elements of the class diagram

associationClasses.description: All AssociationClasses (A8: specialization of value type with event type)

enumerations.description: All Enumerations (from categorical value types, A1)

primitiveTypes.description: All PrimitiveTypes (from non-categorical value types, A2)

Class.title: Class
Class.description: UML Class (concrete or abstract). Inherits from EncapsulatedClassifier and BehavioredClassifier.

isAbstract.description: Whether the class is abstract (A10: abstract parent)

ownedAttributes.description: Attributes (Properties) directly owned by the class

generalizations.description: Generalization relationships from this class to its parent classes

ownedBehaviors.description: Behaviors owned by the class, typically StateMachines (BehavioredClassifier.ownedBehavior)

ownedActivities.description: Activity Diagrams owned by the class, e.g. Set<entity>.<event> or Create<child> activities (A6, A7, A9)

Property.title: Property
Property.description: UML Property (attribute or association end). Inherits from StructuralFeature and ConnectableElement.

type.description: Reference to the type by name (a Class, PrimitiveType, or Enumeration)

isID.description: Whether this property is a logical identifier (A3: logical identifier)

defaultValue.description: Default value of the property as a ValueSpecification

Generalization.title: Generalization
Generalization.description: UML Generalization relationship. References the general (parent) class by name.

Association.title: Association
Association.description: UML Association between two classes (A12: property type). Inherits from Classifier.

memberEnds.description: Exactly two association ends (Properties) with type and multiplicity

AssociationClass.title: AssociationClass
AssociationClass.description: UML AssociationClass: combines Association and Class (A8: specialization of value type with event type and property type).

ownedAttributes.description: Attributes directly owned by the AssociationClass

memberEnds.description: Exactly two association ends (inherited from Association)

Enumeration.title: Enumeration
Enumeration.description: UML Enumeration (DataType). Derived from categorical value types (A1).

EnumerationLiteral.title: EnumerationLiteral
EnumerationLiteral.description: UML EnumerationLiteral. A single value within an Enumeration.

PrimitiveType.title: PrimitiveType
PrimitiveType.description: UML PrimitiveType (DataType). Derived from non-categorical value types (A2), e.g. String, Integer.

StateMachine.title: StateMachine
StateMachine.description: UML StateMachine (Behavior, inherits from Class). Represents the state machine diagram of an entity type (A3, A4, A6).

regions.description: Regions of the state machine (at least 1 region required)

Region.title: Region
Region.description: UML Region of a StateMachine or a composite State. Contains vertices and transitions.

subvertices.description: Vertices of the region: States and Pseudostates (Region.subvertex)

State.title: State
State.description: UML State (Vertex). Can be simple or composite (with sub-regions). Discriminator: _type='State'.

entry.description: Entry behavior of the state (State.entry, e.g. an Alf expression)

Pseudostate.title: Pseudostate
Pseudostate.description: UML Pseudostate (Vertex). Represents control points such as initial state, fork, join, etc. Discriminator: _type='Pseudostate'.

name.description: Optional name of the pseudostate (used for entryPoint/exitPoint)

Transition.title: Transition
Transition.description: UML Transition between two vertices. Has an optional trigger and effect behavior.

effect.description: Optional effect behavior of the transition, e.g. an Alf expression (Transition.effect)

Trigger.title: Trigger
Trigger.description: UML Trigger of a transition (e.g. an Alf expression for an event condition, A6).

Behavior.title: Behavior
Behavior.description: Simplified representation of an abstract UML Behavior. Contains an Alf expression or activity name.

Activity.title: Activity
Activity.description: UML Activity (Behavior, inherits from Class). Represents an activity diagram with coordinated actions. Used for Set<entity>.<event> (A6), Create<child> (A7, A9). Maps to Mendix Microflow (B13).

nodes.description: All nodes of the activity (Activity.node): control nodes, object nodes, actions

edges.description: Control flow edges connecting the nodes (Activity.edge). Maps to Sequence flow (B22).

Parameter.title: Parameter
Parameter.description: UML Parameter of an Activity. Represents typed input or output data. Together with ActivityParameterNode maps to Mendix microflow Parameter (B16).

type.description: Reference to the type by name (a Class, PrimitiveType, or Enumeration)

ControlFlow.title: ControlFlow
ControlFlow.description: UML ControlFlow edge between two ActivityNodes. Vertices are referenced by name. Maps to Mendix Sequence flow (B22).

ActivityNode.title: ActivityNode
ActivityNode.description: Abstract UML ActivityNode. Discriminated union via _type: InitialNode, ActivityFinalNode, ActivityParameterNode, CreateObjectAction, CreateLinkAction, AddStructuralFeatureValueAction, ValueSpecificationAction, ReadStructuralFeatureAction.

InitialNode.title: InitialNode
InitialNode.description: UML InitialNode (ControlNode). Entry point of an Activity. Discriminator: _type='InitialNode'. Maps to Mendix StartEvent (B14).

ActivityFinalNode.title: ActivityFinalNode
ActivityFinalNode.description: UML ActivityFinalNode (FinalNode, ControlNode). Terminal node of an Activity. Discriminator: _type='ActivityFinalNode'. Maps to Mendix EndEvent (B15).

ActivityParameterNode.title: ActivityParameterNode
ActivityParameterNode.description: UML ActivityParameterNode (ObjectNode). Connects an Activity's Parameter to the flow. Discriminator: _type='ActivityParameterNode'. Maps to Mendix Entity reference / Parameter (B16).

parameter.description: Reference to the Parameter by name

CreateObjectAction.title: CreateObjectAction
CreateObjectAction.description: UML CreateObjectAction (Action). Creates a new instance of a classifier. Discriminator: _type='CreateObjectAction'. Maps to Mendix CreateObjectAction (B20).

classifier.description: Name of the Class to instantiate

result.description: Name of the output pin carrying the new object (optional)

LinkEndData.title: LinkEndData
LinkEndData.description: UML LinkEndData: one end of a CreateLinkAction. Pairs an input pin (value) with an association end (Property).

value.description: Name of the input pin providing the object for this end

CreateLinkAction.title: CreateLinkAction
CreateLinkAction.description: UML CreateLinkAction (Action). Creates a link (instance of an Association) between two objects. Discriminator: _type='CreateLinkAction'. Maps to Mendix ChangeObjectAction (B19).

endData.description: Exactly two link end data entries (one per association end)

AddStructuralFeatureValueAction.title: AddStructuralFeatureValueAction
AddStructuralFeatureValueAction.description: UML AddStructuralFeatureValueAction (Action). Sets the value of a structural feature on an object. Discriminator: _type='AddStructuralFeatureValueAction'. Maps to Mendix ChangeObjectAction (B17, B18).

object.description: Name of the input pin providing the target object

structuralFeature.description: Name of the Property to set

value.description: Name of the input pin providing the new value

ValueSpecificationAction.title: ValueSpecificationAction
ValueSpecificationAction.description: UML ValueSpecificationAction (Action). Evaluates a literal value and places it on an output pin. Discriminator: _type='ValueSpecificationAction'. Maps to Mendix Change Object (B17).

ReadStructuralFeatureAction.title: ReadStructuralFeatureAction
ReadStructuralFeatureAction.description: UML ReadStructuralFeatureAction (Action). Reads the value of a structural feature from an object. Discriminator: _type='ReadStructuralFeatureAction'. Maps to Mendix CreateVariableAction (B21).

object.description: Name of the input pin providing the target object

structuralFeature.description: Name of the Property to read

result.description: Name of the output pin for the read value (optional)

ValueSpecification.title: ValueSpecification
ValueSpecification.description: Abstract UML ValueSpecification. Concrete types: LiteralBoolean, LiteralInteger, LiteralUnlimitedNatural.

oneOf.title: LiteralBoolean
oneOf.description: Boolean literal value (e.g. defaultValue=false for an event Boolean, A6)

oneOf.title: LiteralUnlimitedNatural
oneOf.description: Natural number or '*' as a literal value (MultiplicityElement.upper)
